paper_title: Extraterrestrial Axion Search with the Breakthrough Listen Galactic Center Survey
suggested_experiment_name: Breakthrough Listen GBT Galactic Center (NS magnetosphere axion search)
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 1
notes: Foster et al. (2202.08274): search for axion DM conversion to radio photons in Galactic Center neutron star magnetospheres using Breakthrough Listen GBT C-band (4-8 GHz) data. New observed 95% CL upper limit on g_agamma for m_a in 15-35 ueV, reaching ~1e-11 GeV^-1. No numerical table available; the two data points encode the approximate level stated in the abstract ('down to g ~ 1e-11 GeV^-1 for masses between 15 and 35 ueV') as a flat line over the stated mass range — the actual limit curve in Fig. 1 has mass dependence not captured here. DM density: NFW profile normalized to local density 0.346 GeV/cm^3 (DM search, density-dependent).
